units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a:15">Snh. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>דומה לס׳ כותי</he> like a Samaritan beggar (v.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX, end, a Lev. R. s. 5; Rashi: a Samaritan peddler that offers his goods by degrees, from the worse to the better).

senses.gloss: travelling merchant, in gen. merchant. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 2, v. סַהַר; a. e.—Pl. סוֹחֲרִים, סוֹחֲרִין.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:22">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>אחיו … לס׳ וס׳ וכ׳</he> his brothers sold him (Joseph) to the Ishmaelites, the Ishmaelites to the merchants, and the merchants to the Midianites &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 7:2">Shek. VII, 2</cite> <he>סוֹחֲרֵי בהמה</he> cattle merchants (in Jerusalem); a. fr.
